risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantitative disclosure on occupancy, lease expirations, retention, receivables allowances, and portfolio performance, but presents substantial exposure to refinancing constraints, tenant defaults, declining rents, vacancies, and asset impairments. Risk language is heavily conditional and forward-looking, while the discussion of resilience relies partly on general assertions regarding asset quality and balance-sheet strength.
